title: Susan McCasland's Facebook statement on Roswell bodies and debris at Wright-Patterson

tellings.quote: Neil does not have any special knowledge about the ET bodies and debris from the Roswell crash stored at Wright Pad.

plain: In 2026 a woman named Susan McCasland posted a statement on Facebook about a man she calls Neil, and Michels reads it out: "Neil does not have any special knowledge about the ET bodies and debris from the Roswell crash stored at Wright Pad." The Roswell crash is the 1947 incident in New Mexico at the center of claims that the US recovered an alien craft, and "Wright Pad" refers to Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio. The words deny that Neil knows anything special, yet they speak of the bodies and debris being stored there as though that were given. Whether she meant that seriously or ironically, the line Michels quotes does not say.
